{{Quote|Boakie! That little grubber killed Boakie! Give me that ion blaster&mdash;|Tripp|<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />}}
'''Tripp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was part of [[Aeona Cantor]]'s group that was opposed to [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] rule on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], he took part in seizing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] when the latter came to Mindor to rescue [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Shadows of Mindor" />
